name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.database.DatabaseTask
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When the BigBrother diagnostic panel starts, this task scans accessible app storage for SQLite databases and preference files that can be browsed.
disableEffect: The app's databases and preference files will no longer appear in BigBrother's diagnostic browser; the app will keep using them normally.
